transcript.content: Hi, welcome in. To start, can you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

They brought me in because at the fair, during my talk, I climbed up on the tractor and kept jerking the controls to show everybody the “new pattern.” I—I couldn’t make myself stop, even when people were yelling at me.
Before this happened at the fair, had you used any alcohol, drugs, or other substances recently?
I’m not sure what you mean exactly. I don’t know of anything I took before the fair.
Over the past week or so, have you noticed you’ve had much more energy than usual, needed less sleep, or felt unusually elated or irritable?

Yeah. Some mornings I feel like the whole valley’s opening up for me, and I’m grinning for no reason. But then if one of the hired hands questions me, or my wife tells me to slow down, I snap at them like they’ve insulted the family name.
How many days in a row have you been feeling this way—energetic, elated some mornings, and quick to snap at others?
I’m not sure exactly how many days. It’s been going on lately, but I haven’t kept track of it day by day.
Have you ever had a period like this before—days of feeling unusually energetic, elated, or irritable—at any earlier point in your life?
I can’t really say. I don’t remember having a stretch exactly like this before.
Have you ever had a period in your life—weeks or longer—where you felt persistently down, lost interest in things you normally enjoy, or had very low energy?
I’m not sure I’ve had a period like that. I can’t recall being down for weeks at a time or losing interest in everything.
Has anyone in your family—your wife, parents, or siblings—ever told you that you acted this way, with big bursts of energy and irritability, at some point earlier in your life?

Some mornings I’m just grinning, feel like the whole valley’s opening up for me. But then if a hired hand questions me, or my wife tells me to slow down, I snap at them like they’ve insulted the family name.
Have you ever been treated by a doctor, hospitalized, or given medication in the past for any mood problems—whether feeling extremely high or extremely low?
No, I don’t believe I’ve ever been hospitalized or put on medicine for mood problems. I can’t remember a doctor treating me for anything like that.

Thinking back over your whole life—even times that seemed minor or that you didn't see a doctor for—has there ever been another stretch of days when you felt unusually high-energy, irritable, or down, even if it wasn't as intense as now?
I can’t really think of another stretch like that. Maybe I’ve had good days and bad days, but nothing I’d call a period that went on for days.
When you say the whole valley is opening up for you, do you feel you have special powers, importance, or a mission that others don't understand or believe?

I do feel like I’m the one farmer in this county who can show everybody a whole new way of growing. The university people and the lenders ought to listen to me instead of acting like I don’t know what I’m talking about.
